Dana Point residents who travel frequently for vacations, business, or simply want a reliable local groomer have found a trusted partner in Cats Luv Us. Our facility is just a short drive up from the coast, easily accessible via Pacific Coast Highway or the I-5.

Cats Luv Us Boarding Hotel has been serving Dana Point and the surrounding South Orange County communities since 1993. Our cat-exclusive facility at 27601 Forbes Rd in Laguna Niguel is just a short drive from Dana Point, making it convenient for drop-offs and pick-ups. Whether you need overnight boarding, professional grooming, daytime daycare, or medication administration, our trained cat care specialists are here to give your feline companion the love and attention they deserve.
